name: Seinarukana -The Spirit of Eternity Sword 2-
original_name: 聖なるかな -The Spirit of Eternity Sword2-
source:
A journey across infinite worlds.

The Time Tree. Countless branches extending through space, each a world of its own. In one such world, a boy holds within him the soul of an ancient god yearning to break free. He tries to live a normal life, but must constantly struggle against the destructive urges threatening to overwhelm him.

Little does he know that his closest friends also carry the burdens of an age long forgotten. With this destiny comes power; Eternity Swords with incredible might and Guardian Spirits manifested from their very souls. The gods are reborn, friend turns on friend, and an ancient war erupts once more.

Thrown into a world not his own, Nozomu must fight to bring his friends home. He must also discover the true nature of the being within him before it consumes him utterly. Thus begins a journey that will shake the very foundation of the universe. 

[From [url=http://seinarukana.com/]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
一场穿越无穷世界的旅程。

时之树的无数枝桠贯穿空间，每一根枝条都构成一个独立的世界。在其中一个世界里，一名少年体内寄宿着远古神祇的灵魂，那位神祇无时无刻不渴望冲破束缚。少年努力维持平凡的生活，却必须不断抵抗那股几乎要将自己吞没的破坏冲动。

他并不知道，自己最亲近的朋友同样背负着早已被遗忘的远古宿命。宿命也为他们带来了力量：威力惊人的永远神剑，以及由灵魂显现而成的守护灵。众神转生，挚友反目，古老的战争再度爆发。

世刻望被抛入一个不属于自己的世界。为了带朋友们回家，他不得不投身战斗；同时，他还必须在体内的存在将自己彻底吞噬之前，查明其真正本质。一场足以撼动宇宙根基的旅程就此展开。
